## Step 1 — Login creates a session

The app receives a login, creates a session, and saves it so later requests can find it. Separately, a form gives the user immediate success feedback while the server work finishes. These are two stories, so I will keep each causal path intact.

The requested order is: the session travels from creation into storage, then the form changes what the user sees during submission. I start with the session because the form does not depend on it.

Review frame: source:branch · scope: `agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src` · current version: bound branch head

```ts
const session = createSession(userId)
sessions.set(token, session)
```

Summary: the first behavior group connects login-time session creation to later token lookup.
